verdict: Paid ads are off; your Google Business profile is the only active channel.
narrative: This period, no budget ran on Meta or Google Ads, so all measurable engagement came from your Google Business Profile — 56 actions in 28 days including directions, website clicks, and calls. GBP activity dropped 43.75% in the most recent week, with zero actions recorded over the last three days of the window, pointing to reduced local search visibility or a seasonal softening in demand. Your website drew 186 sessions over the 28 days, and a spike mid-week suggests some residual interest, but conversion tracking is being repaired so that number currently under-reports actual contact attempts. Reactivating paid campaigns is the clearest lever to stabilize lead flow and capture the site traffic that organic alone is not converting.
